f_iv: F1/F15 input: contract implied vol at the alert (meta_label_features.iv)
f_iv_rank: F1: IV rank at the alert (0-100), alert-time
f_rv20: F15: trailing 20d realized vol of the underlying, alert-time
f_vrp: F1 Goyal-Saretto (2009): log(RV20 / IV). HIGH = vol is cheap -> buy.
f_hujacobs: F15 Hu & Jacobs: -RV20 for calls, +RV20 for puts. HIGH = favorable side of the vol sort.
f_logmoney: Raw Heber ln(K/S) -- NOT direction-aware, kept for reference
f_otm: F10 Boyer-Vorkink: direction-aware OTM-ness. +ln(K/S) for calls, -ln(K/S) for puts. HIGH = deeper OTM = the lottery wing the literature says to avoid.
f_abs_delta: F10 delta magnitude at the alert
f_vol_oi: F14 volume/OI at the alert (NOT open-buy volume - see literature caveat)
f_ask_share: F5 own-print buyer conviction: (ask_prem - bid_prem)/(ask_prem + bid_prem) on THIS sweep, from Silver flow_alerts. HIGH = more one-sidedly buyer-initiated.
f_trade_count: Number of prints composing the sweep
f_mom_align_5d: 5d underlying return signed by the option's direction. HIGH = trading with the trend.
f_maxpain_dist: Distance of spot from max-pain strike (alert-time vendor field)
f_minutes_open: Minutes since the open at the alert
f_minutes_close: Minutes to the close at the alert
f_prior_flow: F5 Pan-Poteshman analogue: signed net premium of STRICTLY PRIOR alerts on the same ticker in the trailing 24h (+ = bullish). Event-time, no daily aggregate.
f_prior_flow_align: F5 aligned: prior signed net premium in the direction of THIS candidate. HIGH = the prior imbalance agrees with the sweep.
f_mom5d_lag: F11/F6: lagged daily 5d momentum (gold, strict as-of)
f_tox_lag: F13: lagged Heber flow_toxicity_1d (in-house composite, not VPIN)
f_ts_slope_lag: F8: lagged Heber term_structure_slope (NOT Vasquez's construction)
f_gamma_lag: F9: lagged UNSIGNED call+put gamma sum. NOT dealer GEX.
f_sweepshare_lag: Lagged sweep share of option volume
f_hujacobs_lag: F15 on the strictly-lagged gold vol_20d instead of the alert-time RV.
f_mktgex_lag: F9 market-wide: lagged gex_regime net_gex (index only, 1 symbol)
